t: The Debugging Duet: A Collaborative Methodology for AI-Assisted Code Refinement
s: This article details a human-AI collaboration to fix a formatting bug in Excel output generated by AI. The core issue was a broken data flow where competitor column lists were lost, leading to inconsistent styling.
sub: Fixing lost competitor list in AI data flow
Saving canonical competitor list to pip state
AI's reliance on git diffs for proof
